description: This file defines the class SAML2AuthenticateUser, which extends SugarAuthenticateUser and handles SAML2-based user authentication in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It includes methods to authenticate a user based on session data and to load the user upon login.

classes.name: SAML2AuthenticateUser
classes.description: Handles SAML2 authentication logic extending SugarAuthenticateUser.

methods.name: authenticateUser
methods.description: Authenticates a user by verifying session data and user password, returning the user ID if successful.

methods.name: loadUserOnLogin
methods.description: Loads a user into the session upon login after authentication.
